# Houskase

> Houskase — Effortless everyday essentials. Premium towels, tissues, cleaning accessories, kitchen & office supplies delivered across India.

Houskase is an Indian direct-to-consumer brand selling premium household essentials, including face & bath towels, sports towels, dry & wet tissues, kitchen items, office supplies, and cleaning accessories. Both retail and bulk (B2B / RFQ) options are available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, featured products, trending reels, promo banners.
- [Products](/products): Full catalog of towels, tissues, cleaning and household essentials with filters and search.
- [Bulk Order / RFQ](/rfq): Request-for-quotation flow for wholesale and business buyers.
- [About Us](/about-us): Brand story, values, cities served, and quality commitments.
- [Help & FAQ](/help): Orders, shipping, payments, returns, and customer support.
- [Track Order](/courier-tracking): Look up delivery status using an order or AWB number.
